<div class="card-body">
'''Ice Storm (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Mobile Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊雪嵐</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">最も外側のマーカーに配備する。同じ屋外の位置では、その場所にいるすべてのキャラクターが行方不明となる。各ターン、自分の支配フェイズに、嵐は隣のマーカーに移動する。最も内側のマーカーに到達したなら、進行方向が変化する。可動エフェクトは最も外側のマーカーを超えて移動したなら、ロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Ice-Storm-Dark-PSA-148375098.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ホスの苛酷な自然環境の中でも最大の危険は、頻繁に発生し素早く移動する雪嵐だ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Snow storm.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at the outermost marker. At the same exterior site, all characters there become missing. Each turn, during your control phase, the storm moves to an adjacent marker. If it reaches the innermost marker, its direction reverses. The Mobile Effect is lost if it moves beyond the outermost marker.

'''Lore:'''
The greatest danger in Hoth's harsh environment is the frequent, fast-moving ice storm.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ice Storm (Dark)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
